title: Visited Position for an Empty Run
statement: Let $M$ be a nondeterministic Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, let $c$ be a configuration on a fixed input, and choose a work tape $i$. The set of head positions visited on tape $i$ during the run from $c$ under the empty choice word is the singleton containing its initial head position.
hypotheses_covered: A nondeterministic machine with $k$ work tapes
A configuration $c$ on a fixed input
